metadata.name: 17世纪具名地点来源支持的军事、地权调查与公司商贸研究性虚线面和联系线
metadata.source_verification: TCD, PRONI, British Library IOR/G, National Army Museum, Encyclopaedia Iranica, official published event corpus
metadata.provenance_warning: Schematic boxes and line segments generated exclusively from attested named regions, modern representative sites, and artificial readability pads. THEIR GEOMETRY IS NOT A HISTORIC MAP, SURVEY OR ACTUAL AFFECTED AREA.
metadata.quality_note: 2026-10-23 16C-parity: corrected Hormuz/Qeshm Safavid-EIC campaign to E6-T12 instead of Ireland; removed 1658 Bengal factory-to-factory polygon (two trading sites do not substantiate an affected area), retaining verified illustrative connection line. Other schematic polygons remain non-sovereign, non-area-aggregable.
metadata.new_england_1637_note: One Pequot War 1637 dotted reading-only envelope between documented Saybrook and Mystic atlas coordinates. Geometry entirely cartographic; no lines or war route inferred and not a historical front, Indigenous territorial boundary or colony.
metadata.virginia_1610_note: Single 1610 Jamestown/Kecoughtan two-attested-site dotted reader envelope only. 1646/1677 treaty geographic legal terms deliberately remain point referenced until actual cadastral/river boundary verification; no sovereignty polygon.
metadata.jamaica_1658_note: Only one modern Rio Nuevo nonmetric dashed reading box in year 1658, expressly not a surveyed fortress/battle zone and not a Jamaica-wide sovereignty polygon; no Maroon/Nanny Town geometry inferred.
metadata.new_york_t09_20261024: One 1643 nonmetric two-site Dutch attack teaching box. No English occupation or province polygon.
metadata.carolina_e6t09_20261024: One artificial 1680 old/new Charles Town two-site teaching-only dotted region; no territorial or dispossession acreage inferred.
metadata.hbc_editor9_20261024: One nonmetric 1686 James Bay three-fort reader-only dashed polygon; 1670 Rupert's Land charter NEVER converted to a territorial occupation polygon.
metadata.acadia_editor9_20261024: 3 nonmetric source-attested dashed research frames: 1629 two distinct Port-Royal heritage places, 1690 Phips port raid and 1696 Beaubassin village raid. NONE represent occupied or dispossessed polygon.
metadata.editor10_newfoundland_20261024: Two year 1696 only nonmetric port raid reading frames for Ferryland and St John's; all historic political control/Indigenous land area metrics absent; 1694 Ferryland defence separate Point.

properties.name: 1609年阿尔斯特六郡殖民安置：王室没产与英苏承领计划

properties.description: 加拿大公园局确认1696年毁坏Beaubassin殖民聚落，未提供实测房屋破坏范围或行军战线。本框角点人为构造，不得用于英国殖民占领面积统计。
properties.summary_zh: 1696英属新英格兰袭击阿卡迪亚村落是史实；虚线只是便于阅读的地区标识，Siknikt原住民主权不随之消失。
properties.actor_zh: Mi’kmaq等原住民主体以及英格兰／苏格兰／法国各自独立行动的殖民主体

anchor_places.name: 1696 Beaubassin现代地名参考点

properties.spatial_semantics: Artificial nonmetric dashed readers' outline for geographically attested events, NOT British/Scottish/French political control or indigenous land transfer perimeter.
properties.mapping_method: Padded modern named-reference-site coordinates used only for visual comparability; polygon vertices have no historic boundary evidence and cannot support war-extent or captured-area numbers.
properties.provenance_method: Parks Canada archaeology and institutional history confirm named events and two different Port-Royal sites, NOT the rectangular geometry.
properties.uncertainty: 虚线为排版性研究框，面积与实控疆界不能反推；原住民政体、家园与使用权未由此转移。
